column1: # The API is auth-gated — every endpoint returns 401 JSON without a bearer
# token — so header/meta-level informational alerts are expected noise, not
# findings. The ZAP baseline runs with `-l WARN` (fails only on WARN+ alerts);
# these IDs are explicitly ignored so the scan stays deterministic on a
# JSON-only API that sets no browser-facing headers by design.
# FORMAT: exactly two tab-separated columns per line: <alert-id> <action>.
# The zap-baseline parser unpacks `(key, val) = line.split("\t")` — a third
# column crashes it. Comments must be full lines starting with '#'.
